spec.seam: run_entrydelay delegates to run_midsweep, so raw= is threaded through BOTH layers: the twin hands it to run_entrydelay, which passes it down unchanged
spec.join: _entrydelay_arm_cells harvests the book rows, the gaps layer (the delegated arms), the delay rows (the copy this runner republishes) and the E65 answers; the copy/source split is what attributes a moved arm to the repair or to the delegating layer
spec.ladder: _lag_ladder_read reads the lag ladder as a SHAPE: monotone means each extra k sessions costs more (or, for monotone_relief, less); flat means lateness is free on that arm; tolerance 2.0bp
spec.control: the same arm joined against itself; every cell must read delta 0.0 or the join machinery moved the numbers

cutoff_control.comparison: old raw arm vs today raw arm (arm held fixed)

answers.delta_units: each delta is in the units of its column: bp for gaps, percent per year for annualised returns, turns/yr for turnover, sessions for offsets -- the summary max is a max over mixed units and is a screen, not a quantity
answers.delegation_attribution: both layers moved = the ladder itself changed

null_cells.note: a cell null on BOTH arms is not one-sided: at start=2020-01-01 the pre2017 era carries no bars, so those cells are empty by construction in both arms

answers.reading: the repair reaches the delay ladder: 50 of 93 cells move (12 copy, 13 source, 18 book, 0 other) and 0 cell(s) exist on one arm only

honest: descriptive census only: no gate, no verdict on the strategy, no prereg, no trial count, no ledger booking

the lag moves the DECISION session as well as the entry, so a repair that changes which name is picked on a delayed date changes the ladder by construction; an entry-only lag would need an execution-lag hook the engine does not have
the screened arm repairs prints inside the panel it is handed; it does not add or remove bars, so an unchanged universe_members count is a property of the repair, not evidence the panel is clean
ladder shapes are read at a 2bp tolerance and are a description of four fixed lags (1/3/5/10 sessions), not a fitted curve
the copy/source invariant is checked on each arm separately before any delta is read: a face whose published copy disagrees with its own delegated arm cannot attribute a move to the repair
E97 counts the published numbers of this runner; the join covers the book/gap/delay/answers cells, not the pointer fields
